## Deep dive into our core modules
[ Aidbox FHIR Server and Database  Aidbox is a FHIR server and database on PostgreSQL — built for the exact needs of high-load medical products and integrations, without compromising data protection. 
  * FHIR data powered by PostgreSQL — manage, query, and scale your healthcare data with full control
  * Rich API surface: REST, GraphQL, SQL, Bulk Data, and Subscriptions
  * Enterprise-grade security — OAuth 2.0, multitenant, flexible user management, and granular access policies
  * Supports all FHIR versions — load an Implementation Guide (IG) and start using it right away

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/fhir-server) [ Build powerful forms. No coding needed. Formbox  Formbox is a platform to create, manage, and embed medical forms in clinical workflows — with secure, structured data capture using FHIR. 
  * Create forms: No-code builder with 4,000+ coded templates
  * Manage at scale: Reusable libraries, versioning, and governance
  * Run anywhere: Embed in apps, EHR workflows, or share via secure links
  * Structured data capture: Standardized data ready for interoperability and analytics
  * Smart forms: Pre-fill, data extraction, calculations, and dynamic behavior
  * AI-assisted: PDF conversion, multilingual forms, and analytics

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/medical-form) [ Prescribe e-prescriptions with built-in FHIR workflows E-prescription  eRxbox is a FHIR-native prescribing module that connects to the e-prescription network and provides a fast path to certification. 
  * Mapping between FHIR and NCPDP e-prescription resources and workflows
  * Accelerated directory sync for pharmacies and providers
  * Built-in support for NewRx, CancelRx, RxRenewal, and RxChange
  * HIPAA-compliant with audit logs and secure infrastructure

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/erxbox) [ Ensure FHIR compliance as industry standard Smartbox  Smartbox is a comprehensive suite of pre-built FHIR modules that accelerates compliance with ONC certification criteria for (g)(10) and CMS-9115 for healthcare payers. Deploy production-ready APIs and workflows that satisfy regulatory requirements out of the box. 
  * Form builder: A drag-and-drop editor with 3,000+ templates
  * Seamless Integration: Embed directly into apps via web SDK
  * FHIR SDC API: Native support for Bernstein, Exquisite, AddOns
  * Smart features: Pre-fill, logic, auto-calculation, validation
  * AI-ready: Convert PDFs, create multilingual forms, analyze data

Read More  ![Smartbox](https://www.health-samurai.io/assets/logos/Smartbox.svg?v=kp.muguv) ](https://www.health-samurai.io/smartbox) [ ![Payerbox](https://www.health-samurai.io/assets/logos/Payerbox.svg?v=op.muguv) CMS-0057 compliance. Handled. Payerbox  Payerbox is a turnkey CMS-0057 compliance platform for health plans. All four mandated FHIR APIs — Patient Access, Provider Access, Prior Authorization, and Payer-to-Payer — ship pre-built on Da Vinci IGs. Your data stays under your control. 
  * All four CMS-0057-F APIs: Patient Access, Provider Access, Prior Auth, Payer-to-Payer
  * Pre-built on Da Vinci IGs — CARIN BB, PDex, PAS, US Core
  * Connect existing claims, clinical, and eligibility systems without rip-and-replace
  * Deploy managed or self-hosted — your data never leaves your infrastructure

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/cms-0057-f) [ Match your data and resolve clinical vocabularies Termbox  Termbox is a production-first terminology server that lets you manage and use standard clinical vocabularies via FHIR protocols. Think of it as FHIR terminology infrastructure as a cloud service, and integrate with your existing workflows. 
  * Preloaded support: SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10, CPT, UCUM
  * Full FHIR Terminology module: ValueSet, CodeSystem, ConceptMap, Expansion, Subsumes
  * Integration and Deployment: Connect with existing terminology servers and client interfaces, deploy as self-hosted or use managed service for consistent performance, high-uptime and no rate-limits

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/termbox) [ Unify your healthcare data across systems Master Data Management  Aidbox MDM is a FHIR-native identity and data matching engine that eliminates duplicate records and keeps your data consistent across platforms. It helps you maintain a single, trusted source of truth — acting as an MPI (Master Patient Index) for Patients, and supporting Practitioners, Organizations, and other clinical entities. 
  * Probabilistic matching that handles typos and incomplete data
  * Merge/unmerge workflows with full audit history
  * Custom algorithms for scoring matches and sharing rules
  * Scales to millions of records

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/mdmbox) [ Modernize HL7v2 and deliver FHIR to Aidbox Interbox  Interbox is an integration engine with a durable, queue-driven runtime. It streamlines HL7v2 modernization and custom workflows, turning legacy healthcare data into FHIR — with mappings and pipelines you own as code. 
  * High-load ingestion tested on production pipelines with millions of messages
  * Pipelines and HL7v2 → FHIR mappings as TypeScript — version-controlled and tested
  * Hash-based diffing dedupes writes and keeps partial updates from clobbering data
  * Operations UI to watch traffic, resolve mapping gaps, and retry failures — nothing dropped

Read More  ](https://www.health-samurai.io/interbox)
